step_metadata.name: Functional Architecture Visualization
step_metadata.description: Generate human-readable visualizations for stakeholder validation

rationale: CRITICAL: Stakeholders cannot validate machine-readable JSON (functional_architecture.json). Must create visual diagrams using industry-standard notation (BPMN, UML) to enable stakeholder understanding and validation.

process_flows_bpmn.purpose: Show sequence of functional operations using BPMN 2.0 notation
process_flows_bpmn.shows: Start events, tasks, gateways (decisions), end events, sequence flows

decision_trees.purpose: Show branching logic and conditions using decision tree notation

data_flows_uml.purpose: Show data movement and transformation using UML data flow notation
data_flows_uml.shows: Data sources, transformations, data stores, data sinks

functional_dependencies.purpose: Show which functions call which other functions (dependency graph)
functional_dependencies.shows: Functions as nodes, function calls as directed edges

tool_usage.fallback_if_tool_not_exists: Manually create Mermaid diagrams from functional_architecture.json, then render with mermaid-cli or online Mermaid editor

includes: Function catalog (all atomic functions with inputs/outputs)
documentation_generation.fallback_if_tool_not_exists: Manually write docs/FUNCTIONAL_ARCHITECTURE.md describing functional architecture

visualization_standards.colors: Use colors meaningfully (green = start, red = error, blue = normal flow)
visualization_standards.legends: Include legend explaining symbols and colors
visualization_standards.layout: Left-to-right or top-to-bottom flow for readability

success_criteria.stakeholder_ready: Visualizations clear enough for non-technical stakeholders

typical_time: 1-2 hours (if tools exist), 3-4 hours (if manual creation)
